webhook.title: Webhook URL
webhook.subtitle: Copy this URL to LINE Developers › Messaging API › Webhook settings
webhook.empty: Save the Channel first and a URL will be created
webhook.manualNeeded: Could not set up the webhook automatically. Copy the URL above into LINE Developers yourself
webhook.afterCopy: After copying, set up the LINE side as follows

steps.paste: Paste the URL into the Webhook URL field and click Verify
steps.disableAutoReply: Turn off Auto-reply messages and Greeting messages in LINE Official Account Manager so the bot doesn't reply twice

webhook.warning: This URL is tied to your workspace. Do not share it with others

configured.title: 1. LINE is set up correctly
configured.ok: The URL matches this system and Use webhook is on
configured.okUnchecked: The URL is set and Use webhook is on (URL not compared because the server has no PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL)
configured.mismatch: The URL LINE is using does not match this system. Copy the URL above into LINE Developers again
configured.inactive: Use webhook is not turned on in LINE Developers
configured.missing: No Webhook URL is set in LINE Developers
configured.unknown: Could not read the setting from LINE right now. Check again

reachable.title: 2. LINE can reach the server
reachable.idle: Click Send test event to have LINE send a sample event to this URL

reasons.COULD_NOT_CONNECT: LINE could not connect to the server. Check the domain, port and firewall
reasons.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The server took too long to respond and LINE gave up
reasons.ERROR_STATUS_CODE: The server answered HTTP {{status}} (404 = wrong URL path, 401 = Channel secret does not match LINE, 5xx = server problem)
reasons.UNTRUSTED_CERTIFICATE: LINE does not trust the server's SSL certificate. Check the domain's certificate
reasons.UNKNOWN: The test failed for a reason LINE did not specify

live.title: 3. In real use
live.none: No real message from LINE yet. Try sending the bot a message from your own LINE account
live.last: Last event received {{when}} ({{count}} in the last 24 hours)

line.title: LINE Messaging API
line.subtitle: Enter the details from the LINE Developers Console for the Channel you want to connect
line.channelIdHint: Found in the Basic settings tab of the Channel. Digits only
line.channelSecretHint: 32 characters, 0-9 and a-f. Used to verify the webhook signature so messages really come from LINE. Found in the Basic settings tab
line.accessTokenHint: Found in Messaging API › Channel access token (long-lived). Click Issue
line.encryptedNote: Data is encrypted before storage and will not be shown again after saving
line.lockedNote: Saved and encrypted. Only the last 4 characters are shown. Click Edit to enter new values
line.envNote: The system is currently using values from the server environment. Save here to manage the Channel from this page

validation.channelIdDigits: Channel ID must be digits only
validation.secretFormat: Channel secret may only contain 0-9 and a-f
validation.secretLength: Channel secret must be exactly 32 characters
validation.tokenFormat: Access token contains invalid characters. Check for spaces or line breaks
validation.tokenShort: Access token is too short. Check that you copied all of it

errors.invalidToken: LINE rejected this Channel access token. Check that it is complete and has not been reissued
errors.ownerOnly: Only the owner can connect LINE
errors.conflict: This LINE Official Account is already connected to another company
errors.lineUnreachable: Cannot reach LINE right now. Please try again
errors.notReady: The system is not ready to store encrypted data. Please contact your administrator

toast.webhookManual: Saved, but the webhook could not be set up automatically. Copy the URL into LINE Developers

ownerOnly.title: Owner only
ownerOnly.description: Only an account with the owner role can set up the LINE connection

idle.title: LINE is not connected
idle.description: Fill in the form on the left and save. The system will test the connection right away

testing.title: Testing connection
testing.description: Checking the token with LINE and setting up the webhook

connected.title: Connected successfully
connected.description: The system is ready to receive customer messages via LINE
connected.envDescription: Connected using server values. The system is ready to receive customer messages via LINE

failed.title: Connection failed
failed.description: Check the Channel ID, secret and access token, then try again
